evaluation_target.rationale: The hazard defines unintended braking as the hazardous event, and SG-3 explicitly states that the system shall prevent unintended braking.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Vehicle braking behavior in the driving situation where the ego vehicle travels straight ahead on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Situations within the stated operational situation in which the vehicle may brake, including normal braking to avoid obstacles and unintended braking without an obstacle in front.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The concern is about braking in the specific operational situation described by the hazard, and FR-7 indicates the relevant braking behavior is collision-avoidance braking in the presence of obstacles.

distinctions.dimension: presence of an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle
distinctions.contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the vehicle in the driving scene.
distinctions.contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the vehicle in the driving scene.
distinctions.rationale: The hazardous event is the vehicle suddenly stopping although no obstacle is in front, while FR-7 frames braking as intended to avoid collisions with obstacles. Collapsing these cases would lose the information needed to determine whether braking is warranted or unintended.

distinctions.dimension: whether braking occurs as a maneuver to avoid collisions versus as a sudden stop without a front obstacle
distinctions.contrast_a: Braking occurs as a collision-avoidance maneuver.
distinctions.contrast_b: The vehicle suddenly stops without a front obstacle.
distinctions.rationale: The safety goal is specifically to prevent unintended braking, and FR-7 defines the intended braking maneuver. Collapsing intended collision-avoidance braking with unintended sudden stopping would remove the evaluative basis for judging compliance with the safety goal.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether an obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle within the stated operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish obstacle-present from no-obstacle-present cases in front of the vehicle.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether braking is occurring as an obstacle-avoidance maneuver or as an unintended sudden stop in the absence of a front obstacle.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish collision-avoidance braking from sudden stopping without a front obstacle.
